verdict.rationale: The only SDK-related signal is Stripe's own llms.txt, which tells readers to check the npm registry for the latest version when installing Stripe packages. That implies official client packages exist, alongside documented APIs (Subscriptions, Trial Offer, Meter Events) that such packages would wrap. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs and their supported languages, SDK coverage of Billing endpoints, SDK usage examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.
